command: fabio item update-table-metadata --workspace <WS> --id <ITEM> --schema dbo --table sales --content '{"description":"Sales transactions"}' --dry-run
description: Read-only before/after preview of an additional-metadata replacement. Default merge preserves unrelated tags and column metadata; --overwrite requests full replacement.

warnings: Updates through shortcuts affect the target table. Read-modify-write is not atomic.

notes: Dry-run reads metadata but never posts. The real POST replaces all additional metadata, even in client merge mode; coordinate writers. Real execution returns status:acknowledged, destructive:true, verified (writable-metadata equality after omitting resolved columnId fields), metadata, readback, verificationError and retriable:false. A failed/mismatched readback does not authorize replay. --overwrite removes fields omitted from the supplied object and is a safety-bypass requiring explicit approval. Metadata is not table rows, item organizational tags or semantic-model descriptions.
query_examples: fabio item get-table-metadata --workspace <WS> --id <ITEM> --schema dbo --table sales --query columns --readonly
